source.name: HubEgo-100K v1.0
license_evidence: Official dataset card declares CC BY 4.0 including commercial use with attribution
Paper datasheet states all recordings are first-party and reports no third-party rights restrictions
source.access_requirement: Login plus short form requesting name, organization, country, and intended use
source.reported_imu: nominal 100 Hz; rate varies by device/OS
source.annotation_provenance: machine-generated action, difficulty, and language labels

public_tree_snapshot.scope_note: Visible metadata listing only; not a complete media payload inventory
public_tree_snapshot.canonical_rows: sorted type|path|size|oid, UTF-8, newline-delimited with final newline

scope.proposed_task: four-choice action-family decision from synchronized video and IMU windows
scope.proposed_split: contributor-disjoint train/validation/sealed-audit; stratify eligible action families using train-only group counts
scope.outputs: source screen only; no payload, features, or weights in Git

constraints: Hugging Face access is gated and requires account login plus an access form; do not submit personal details on the user's behalf
paper says action annotations are machine-generated and not human-audited
task-specific action-family support by contributor must be checked before split freeze
no source-held-out result or both-input benefit may be claimed until controls pass on unseen contributors
visible file-tree sizes do not represent total media payload size
